Added now parameters to decideBooking and listOpenRequests, and the reason 'started' in DecideResult. First CI run was red: the new clock check made four fixed-date tests and the example seed refuse approvals of October 2026 fixtures on the real clock. Fixed the seed (passes now) and pinned Date to each test's NOW. Merged as PR #350. Next: the queue of the next ticket.
